takeaway: The coeliac trunk is closely related to the fibres of the greater splanchnic nerves.

lines.text: This question is about vascular supply in the upper abdomen.
Which artery is closely related to the greater splanchnic nerves?
Follow these nerve fibres down beside the aorta.
They wrap closely around the coeliac trunk.
So the answer is the coeliac trunk, a branch of the abdominal aorta.
Remember: greater splanchnic nerves, close to the coeliac trunk.
Greater splanchnic nerves and the coeliac trunk: keep these two together.
